body:
failing example

``` python
import numpy as np
import numba as nb


@nb.guvectorize('f8[:], f8[:], f8[:]', '()->(),()', nopython=True, target='cuda')
def foo(inp, out1, out2):
    out1[0] = inp[0] * 2.3
    out2[0] = inp[0] + 1

inp = np.arange(10, dtype=np.float64)
out1 = np.empty_like(inp)
out2 = inp
for _ in range(3):
    foo(inp, out=(out1, out2))
    print('out1', out1)
    print('out2', out2)
```
title: improve cuda gufunc: multiple output arguments
